description: RAPID: A Coordinated Structural Engineering Response to Hurricane Irma (and Hurricane Maria in the US Virgin Islands) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Tracy Kijewski-Correa, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). The active 2017 hurricane season included multiple hurricanes impacting the United States from its mainland to the US Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Hurricane, wind, storm surge, damage assessment, Puerto Rico, Maria. Published 2020-02-11. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
